lastCompletedStory.title: Re-arm implementing at sidecar boot and idle-tick for in-flight PRDs

nextStoryContext: The re-arm gate this story added is a NEW, separate seam from evaluateDrainPreconditions (drain-preconditions.ts) -- do not conflate the two if a future story touches either. `evaluateRearmPreconditions` (new file src/supervisor/rearm-preconditions.ts) checks exactly 3 things, matching the AC's own parenthetical definition literally (not the container/auto evaluateDrainPreconditions): (1) prdInFlight (pass makeHasPendingStories()'s result directly -- it ALREADY returns false at the MAX_ROUNDS_DEBT blocked terminal per the CAM-109 guard, so 'no blocked terminal' needed no separate verdict read), (2) phase==='implementing' EXACTLY (LoopPhase is a mutually-exclusive enum, so this one check also covers 'no plan/ship phase in progress' -- phase:idle/planning/shipping all fail it, satisfying AC2's 'phase:idle never resumes'), (3) no pending merge-watch marker (existsSync .claude/MERGE_WATCH_FILENAME). Wiring: a new `rearmImplementingFn?: () => boolean` option on RunSidecarLoopOptions (loop.ts), production factory `makeProductionRearmImplementingFn(claudeDir, cwd, hasPendingStoriesFn, readLoopPhaseFn)` (sidecar.ts, exported), wired unconditionally (NOT gated by meta_loop/plan_approval, unlike flipActiveFn/autoShipFn) via a new `buildRearmDeps` helper (extracted purely to stay under buildSidecarLoopDeps' biome cognitive-complexity(15) ceiling -- do not inline it back). loop.ts's idle branch (`active !== true`) now checks `opts.rearmImplementingFn?.()` as the VERY FIRST thing, before runMergeWatchFn/runMetaLoopObserveFn: when it returns true, the tick sleeps and continues immediately (skips merge-watch/observe THIS tick) so the freshly-written active:true is picked up cleanly on the next tick without racing a same-tick meta-loop dispatch write (AC3). There is no separate 'sidecar boot' code path in runSidecarLoop -- the FIRST iteration of its `while(true)` already IS the boot check, so AC1's 'at sidecar boot AND at the idle-tick' needed only ONE call site, not two. When re-arm fires it writes phase:implementing via the existing makeSetPhaseFn (same write flipActiveFn already used for the auto-chain elsewhere) which derives active:true through renderStateFile's effectivePhase==='implementing' rule (US-001/US-002 of this same PRD, already shipped, made phase:implementing on disk trustworthy across an orchestrator restart). No event is logged on rearm fire or refuse in this story (kept surgical to the AC's scope) -- eventing every dispatch refusal/terminal is explicitly US-007's job (requires: US-003), which should add symmetric logging here if/when it touches this new seam. US-004/US-005/US-006 (this PRD, independent of US-003/US-007) cover the structured-event + durable implement-blocked-marker half of the CAM-195 fix and do not depend on this story's rearm wiring.
